title: Food Tour of Local Orlando's Ivanhoe Village
includes: Snack-sized tidbits of area and culinary history
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
We do our best to accommodate dietary needs, but menu differences between brunch and afternoon tours may limit some options.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This is more than a food tour. It is a locally owned, small group experience designed to feel personal, relaxed, and genuinely connected to Orlando. With thoughtfully curated tastings, neighborhood storytelling, and your choice of a brunch or afternoon tour, you will explore Ivanhoe Village beyond the typical tourist path while supporting the local businesses that make this community so special.

Each tour includes multiple tastings that come together as a full meal, with a progression of flavors from savory to sweet. Along the way, you will enjoy scenic lake views, vibrant murals, and the creative energy that defines this historic Main Street district.

Whether you are visiting Orlando or live here, this experience offers a deeper look at the city through its food, stories, and local connections, all at a comfortable pace that allows you to truly enjoy each stop.
